name: Item Creation
title: Item Creation: one general equipment profession
summary: Item Creation is the single profession that creates all equipment families from selected bases and resources. Its starting modifier-count formula uses the skill as the main input, Perception as up to a 10% relative bonus, and the shared Luck multiplier; fixed base type weights are unaffected. Enchanting is a separate profession.
scenarioNote: Отдельный проигранный сценарий в этот импорт не входил.

points.text: Item Creation creates all armour, weapons, jewellery, and accessories from bases/resources; separate material-family crafting professions are retired.
Skill levels 1, 11, …, 91 unlock item stages 9, 8, …, 0; any lower stage remains craftable when materials are supplied.
Six independent modifier-slot trials use p=min(0.99,(0.10+0.60×((ItemCreation−1)/99))×(1+0.10×((Perception−1)/99))×(1+Luck/100)); type weights remain fixed per base.
Higher item stages increase the weight of stronger modifier tiers; no hard tier ceiling applies.
The Vertical Slice still defers deep crafting; this update does not authorise implementation.

gaps: Final base catalogue, per-base favored modifier types and weights, stage/tier tables, numeric ranges, recipes, resource costs, timing, and later balance tuning remain open.
